audit_sample_20_seed42.text_snippet: Geological model proven correct but dry: migration failure and lower reservoir quality.

audit_sample_20_seed42.name: Ronaldo
audit_sample_20_seed42.text_snippet: The only geological prospect with potential for commercial development on PL-434 was the Ronaldo horst structure. This prospect failed due to containment (topseal breach) as demonstrated by the 6507/8-8 well.

audit_sample_20_seed42.name: Lorry
audit_sample_20_seed42.text_snippet: Drilled by 6407/10-4: some shows but dry, apparently lacking effective seal; failed to drill the proposed Jurassic or Permian reservoir units and instead penetrated 830 m of Triassic clastic sediment.

audit_sample_20_seed42.name: Solaris
audit_sample_20_seed42.text_snippet: Main target, Solaris, has been found dry. The main risk, seal breach, has been identified as the main cause of failure of this prospect.

audit_sample_20_seed42.name: Vollgrav South
audit_sample_20_seed42.text_snippet: The well proved no hydrocarbon bearing reservoir within the prospect intervals and was characterized as dry. Due to the disappointing results the volumes for the Vollgrav South prospect has been signed off.

audit_sample_20_seed42.name: Copernicus
audit_sample_20_seed42.text_snippet: Unfortunately, the Copernicus well 6608/1-1 S was dry and failed on reservoir presence within the Copernicus anomaly.

audit_sample_20_seed42.name: Crossbill
audit_sample_20_seed42.text_snippet: Drilled dry; it is most likely that the source rock in the local kitchen is not mature enough and Crossbill has no access to long distance migration from the Sogn Graben. The updip potential is not likely to be economic.

audit_sample_20_seed42.name: Geite
audit_sample_20_seed42.text_snippet: Good quality reservoir but water bearing; migration/timing probably the main failure.

audit_sample_20_seed42.name: Snurrevad
audit_sample_20_seed42.text_snippet: No sands were encountered in the Knurr Fm., suggesting that the location may have been too distal for sand deposition.

audit_sample_20_seed42.name: Haribo
audit_sample_20_seed42.text_snippet: Well 2/11-11 was drilled in 2015 but proved to be dry with poorer reservoir properties than expected.

audit_sample_20_seed42.name: Pabow
audit_sample_20_seed42.text_snippet: The Pabow well result came out negative, confirming no hydrocarbons at any stratigraphic levels. As there is still a high risk on the presence of source and the well did not confirm the maturation, the license is believed to be of limited interest.

audit_sample_20_seed42.name: Lamba
audit_sample_20_seed42.text_snippet: Lamba prospect condemned by 25/7-10 well. No further prospectivity identified. Based on the well results, the license area seems to have poor reservoir development and the prospectivity has been downgraded mainly due to lack of reservoir.

audit_sample_20_seed42.name: Fat Canyon
audit_sample_20_seed42.text_snippet: Drilled dry by 6306/3-1 S/S T2; most likely failed on lateral seal. With no other prospects or leads, the licence was dropped at the BoK milestone.
